raw_segments.text: And he have one, two, three—oh! good many iron in him hide, too, Captain," cried Queequeg
disjointedly—"all twiske-tee be-twisk, like him—him—" faltering hard for a word,
and screwing his hand round and round as though uncorking a bottle—"like him—him—"
And he have one, two, three, Oh, good many iron in him hide, too, Captain,
Cried Queequeg disjointedly, All Twisk T.B. Twisk, like him him,
Faltering hard for a word, And screwing his hand round and round
As though uncorking a bottle, Like him him.
And he have one, two, three—oh, good many iron in him hide, too, captain!" cried
Queekweg disjointedly, all twisty-be-twisk, like him him, faltering hard for a word and
screwing his hand round and round as though uncorking a bottle, like him him.
